summary: Covers entities that rent or lease passenger vehicles, including car-sharing models. Disclosure topics are customer safety and fleet fuel economy and utilisation.

questions.text: What percentage of your rental fleet vehicles are rated by NCAP with an overall 5-star safety rating, by region?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) · Report the percentage by region, for models rated by a New Car Assessment Programme (NCAP) with an overall 5-star rating.

questions.text: How many vehicles did your organisation recall?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the total number of vehicles recalled during the reporting period.

questions.text: What is your rental day-weighted rental fleet average fuel economy, by region?
questions.hint: Unit: Mpg, L/km, gCO2/km, km/L · Report by region, in the unit(s) you use: mpg, L/km, gCO2/km or km/L, and state the weighting method.

questions.text: What is your fleet utilisation rate?
questions.hint: Unit: Rate · Report fleet utilisation as a rate (for example rental days divided by available rental days) and state the calculation.

questions.text: What is the average age of your vehicles?
questions.hint: Unit: Months · Report the average vehicle age in months.

questions.text: What are your total available rental days?
questions.hint: Unit: Days · Report total available rental days for the reporting period.

questions.text: What was your average rental fleet size?
questions.hint: Unit: Number of vehicles · Report the average rental fleet size as a number of vehicles.
